preprocess_oneformer_images: preprocess images with OneFormerImageProcessor for semantic, instance, or panoptic segmentation tasks
post_process_instance_segmentation: post process OneFormer model outputs into instance segmentation predictions with masks and segment info
post_process_panoptic_segmentation: post process OneFormer model outputs into panoptic segmentation predictions fusing stuff classes
post_process_semantic_segmentation: post process OneFormer model outputs into semantic segmentation maps per class
convert_segmentation_map_to_binary_masks: convert a segmentation map tensor to binary masks and class labels for training or evaluation
